issue_context.title: OpenSSL 3.0.0-alpha2 can't serialize ed25519 or ed448 keys to PKCS8
comments: True.  The PKCS#8 PEM and i2d routines haven't been converted to deal with provider side keys yet.
ed25519/ed448 keys also appear to be unable to perform signatures in `X509_CRL_sign` and `X509_sign`. I can open another issue for this if desired, but didn't want to clutter the issue tracker.

Would you mind trying #11855?

As for the X509_CRL_sign / X509_sign problem, please create another issue for them.
@levitte I can test this tomorrow and will open a new issue for the X509 functions as well.
The PR you linked (or at least it applied against the master branch) does allow serialization and all my tests pass against it.
